text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH - unusual auth attempts observed across multiple customer namespaces via auth-proxy. Alert ID: https://alerts.redwood/ALRT-639101. Sampling shows Authorization header snippets persisted into the analytics pipeline. Impact estimate: ~5 tenants.

mia_oncall: ack — grabbing triage. @oliver_sre can you confirm the blast radius and whether logs are still flowing out?

oliver_sre: looking now. confirmed: some Authorization headers were logged to /var/log/proxy/requests.log between 01:02:10 and 01:09:54 UTC. Masking flag appears unset for those entries. snippet:

```
[2026-07-11T01:03:12Z] proxy: GET /v1/search?tenant=acme Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR...
```

oliver_sre: the logmasker sidecar skipped entries if upstream set `X-Log-Mask: false`. Investigating recent rollout to collector-config.

akshay_sec: Sec here. Priority: contain and prevent exfil. Immediate actions: 1) pause analytics forwarder to external buckets; 2) rotate service-account keys used by exporters; 3) revoke recently issued short-lived tokens. I'll own key rotation.

sophie_cs: prepping customer comms. Which tenants are impacted? I have acme, beta-inc, zenpay, orbitai, microline on initial list.

mia_oncall: initiating containment: disabling analytics-forwarder path. @deploy-bot please roll back rollout:collector-config v2026-07-11 to previous stable.

deploy-bot: rollback requested by mia_oncall. Rollback job id: rb-2026-07-11-01 queued. ETA ~90s.

oliver_sre: rollback applied. Forwarding to external S3 paused. No new deliveries since 6391012349. :white_check_mark:

akshay_sec: starting scoped key swap for exporters. Will rotate SA keys, update KMS entries, and revoke short-lived tokens issued in last 10m. Legal/CS, stand by.

mia_oncall: run immediate session revocation for tokens issued in the window.

oliver_sre: executed revocation script:
```
/bin/revoke-sessions --filter "issued_at>2026-07-11T01:00:00Z AND path='/proxy/*'"
```
Result: 530 sessions invalidated. Applied egress deny on analytics workers to public S3 endpoints.

akshay_sec: forensic note: no external pulls to non-approved buckets observed beyond expected. Likely a masking misconfiguration caused internal retention of header fields, not an external exfil. Full grep across 24h archive in progress.

legal_ops: looped in. Preparing internal timeline template and regulatory checklist. Will advise on customer disclosure once sec confirms PII/credentials exposure.

sophie_cs: drafting tenant-specific notes, will not send until sec confirms what's in logs.

mia_oncall: question: are model-serving keys affected by rotation? akshay_sec?

akshay_sec: no — rotation scoped to analytics exporter SA. Model-serving and core infra keys untouched. We'll issue scoped secrets with limited lifetime and update k8s secrets via secret-manager.

oliver_sre: rolling exporter pods as part of secret rotation (kubectl rollout restart deploy/analytics-exporter) — doing canary, then full. Monitoring CPU/latency.

mia_oncall: monitoring looks stable, no customer-facing errors reported. Marking incident channel and updating pager. Handing operational lead to oliver_sre in 30m.

deploy-bot: deployment rollback rb-2026-07-11-01 completed at 6391012355.

akshay_sec: added timeline and remediation notes to incident tracker: https://redwood.inc/incident/6391012345. Next: complete grep, produce data classification (PII/credentials), and confirm retention windows.

mia_oncall: actions summary: sec — finish grep & classification; legal — prepare disclosure guidance; cs — hold drafts; sre — keep forwarder paused and egress rule for 12h. On-call rotation: mia_oncall -> oliver_sre (ack).

oliver_sre: ack, taking lead for next 6h. Will post updates every 30m or on blocker changes.

sophie_cs: standing by to notify customers once sec gives clearance.

akshay_sec: preliminary forensics will be posted to the tracker within 45 minutes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
